steps.text: Melanie wants a water slide for Galaxity. Go with her to ask Mr. Palmer at his Town Hall window (he's in from morning till teatime).
Mr. Palmer said no. But why was the old slide in the Spooky Woods closed? Ask around town.
Look for clues at the old slide, by the Haunted House in the Spooky Woods.
checklist: Read the old notice on the slide
Look at the glowing puddle by the Haunted House

steps.text: A very fancy stranger is waiting by the Haunted House. Talk to him.
Mr. Goldwhistle says the slide could go in the Haunted House. Try its old front door.
Something escaped from the Haunted House! Tell Melanie what happened.
Melanie has a new plan, and it doesn't need the waterfall or the Haunted House. Take it to Mr. Palmer (morning till teatime).

reward.message: Mr. Palmer said YES! The Cloud Water Slide (with a toy store on top) will be floating over the lake next time you visit. +10 sparkles.
